defects.title: V13-PAY-003 evidence folder missing
defects.invariant: Every Done task must have an evidence/<Task-ID>/ folder with reproducible acceptance proof (AGENTS.md line 82-83, V1-RMD-433)
defects.mechanism: Task V13-PAY-003 is marked Done but no evidence/V13-PAY-003/ directory exists in the repository. The task's Acceptance evidence section lists 8/8 TenderComposition tests passing, regression tests across 4 test suites, and audit tool passes, but these artifacts were not persisted to the required evidence folder. Additionally, the task was marked Done while its declared dependency V13-MCD-004 was not Done — waived by V13-GOV-008 but this waiver itself needs evidence.
defects.acceptance: Create evidence/V13-PAY-003/ with test logs, build output, and audit tool outputs matching the Acceptance evidence claims. Document the V13-MCD-004 waiver (V13-GOV-008) with approval record. Re-run tests if needed to generate fresh artifacts.

limitations: Task is marked Done with detailed Acceptance evidence in its plan file, but the mandatory evidence folder per AGENTS.md and V1-RMD-433 was never created. The V13-MCD-004 dependency waiver via V13-GOV-008 is documented in the task but the gate waiver evidence itself is not in the evidence folder. No runtime verification possible in this read-only review.
